name: beatZIG gen3
what: a small network scores the moves; a reader ("one", k=2) looks at the best 2 by score on re-drawn states and picks the better

frozenCode.note: The CPU module imports only the copies in its own folder; cpus/learned/ and the others may change without changing how it plays. sha256 of each file with line endings read as LF; all = sha256 of the hashes in the order listed.

learnedFor.note: The rules the data was played under. When the game's rules change (the first-turn draw, a card, a rule version), the data and this CPU are of the old rules: learn it again.

evaluation.note: Strength = the share of matches won, both seat orders, every pair of the 7 start decks, game f9d9e2b (rule version 2.0-public-staging.20, cards beta0.9.2-cards.16), sim prior "seen" (what the seat has seen, never the other side's decklist); 95% range: Wilson.
evaluation.measuredAs: the same network and the reader (topk k=2, reader one, samples 2), played from a file of its own before freezing; 980 and 490 matches against simple and lookahead
evaluation.versusNoReader: against the same network with no reader (lightZIG form): simple +1.5 points (z 0.71), lookahead +2.8 points (z 0.90): not different at this number of matches.

anomalies.note: refused window answers, stopped or capped matches, exceptions: none

evaluation.checkAfterFreeze: 196 matches against simple (seed 2, both orders, all deck pairs): 137 wins, 59 losses, the same count as before it was frozen; 187 of the 196 matches identical (the reader's re-drawn states follow the match name, which is the file name of the CPU, so some matches play out differently under another name).

timePerDecision.note: choose() of the CPU with the reader. The CPU against itself, 12 matches, 2 passes, one worker, a desktop (i5-9600K) at about 30% load; the sim prior is "seen"; the time includes the bench opening the sim (re-drawing the hidden cards), which a device would do in its own way. Milliseconds. The device the game runs on is not measured.

playsOnly: what the seat can see (its own query) and the states the reader re-draws of what it cannot see; no hidden information of the other side.
